body.message: We need a little more information before suggesting paths. Answer the questions below, starting with the first. You can skip any you prefer not to answer.

otherCareers.title: AI/ML Engineering
otherCareers.summary: AI/ML Engineering helps build systems that learn from data and make useful predictions or decisions.

otherCareers.title: Cybersecurity
otherCareers.summary: Protect computer systems, networks, people, and personal data from digital threats.

otherCareers.title: Data Careers
otherCareers.summary: Build practical data skills through one focused learning track, consistent practice, and one or two portfolio projects.

otherCareers.title: Cloud Computing (AWS)
otherCareers.summary: Learn cloud concepts and AWS services, deploy real projects, document architecture and security decisions, and optionally pursue entry-level certification.

otherCareers.title: Full Stack Web Development
otherCareers.summary: Build complete web applications end-to-end by learning front-end interfaces, back-end APIs, databases, version control, and deployment.

otherCareers.title: Intro to Coding
otherCareers.summary: A four-week beginner track for learning programming fundamentals with JavaScript and browser-based tools, then sharing a small portfolio of projects.

otherCareers.title: Quantum Computing
otherCareers.summary: Explore quantum information and computation by learning core concepts, building circuits, and testing small simulations with tools such as Qiskit.

otherCareers.title: AI Safety, Alignment and Governance
otherCareers.summary: Study how to make AI systems more reliable, controllable, accountable, and beneficial, spanning technical alignment, evaluations, governance, and responsible deployment.

otherCareers.title: Project Management, Agile and Workflow Automation
otherCareers.summary: Learn to define project scope, coordinate stakeholders, manage time and risks, run iterative delivery, and automate repeatable workflows using project-management tools.

explore.hint: You can browse every career path while you decide what to answer.

body.scoreNote: This is a heuristic fit score (0 to 100) based only on the answers you gave. It is not a prediction of success and not a judgement of your potential. Use it to explore.
